metadata.title: fix: remove unmaintained rustls-pemfile from MCP runtime
metadata.author: lucarlig

description:
## Summary
- remove the unmaintained `rustls-pemfile` dependency from the Rust MCP runtime
- switch `sslrootcert` PEM loading to `rustls`' maintained `pki_types` API and keep the existing validation behavior
- cover PEM parsing with runtime-generated test input and tighten the live-stream timing test to avoid suite-order flakiness

Closes #3877

reviews.author: dima-zakharov
reviews.body:
✅ Commit 54896cc2e - Removes rustls-pemfile dependency:
     - Clean migration to built-in CertificateDer::pem_slice_iter
     - Well-structured load_pem_certificates() function with proper error handling
     - Validates empty certificate lists (security check)

    ✅ Commit 3cae79db3 - Fixes test panic:
     - Gracefully handles systems with empty certificate stores
     - Returns Option<String> instead of panicking
     - Test skips gracefully when no native certs available
